I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/matio`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow in Mat_VarPrint (src/mat.c): when printing sparse matrix variables the function's inner loop can index past the allocated sparse arrays, performing out-of-bounds 4-byte reads from heap memory. The insufficient bounds checking on the sparse data/indices can lead to crashes, memory corruption, or other undefined behavior.
